record: National Register historical development of Myrtle Beach
facts: The hotel was completed in 1930 as a separate resort building and demolished in 1974.

record: City of Myrtle Beach historic landmark description
facts: Opened to the public in February 1930. The central ten-story tower and two five-story wings were across from the ocean-side cabana section.

record: City historic memorial schematic, plan text and site controls
facts: The original site lay directly on the surviving Porcher Drive entry axis between Porcher Drive and North Ocean Boulevard. The hotel was removed September 13, 1974.
The opening celebration took place February 21, 1930. The landmark tower and wings stood on a dune plateau around 29 feet above sea level.
